scenarios.name: Double-click an inactive ribbon tab before cycling its display

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software
the full 3D Model ribbon is visible
the ribbon display control is set to cycle through all modes
the user double-clicks the inactive Tools tab
the full Tools ribbon is visible
the user double-clicks the active Tools tab
the Tools ribbon displays panel buttons
the user double-clicks the active Tools tab three more times
the full Tools ribbon is visible again
